summary.text: Anne Charnock is a Republican member of the West Virginia Senate representing District 17, which covers part of Kanawha County.
She chairs the Senate Confirmations Committee and is a lawyer.

paragraphs.text: Charnock's page lists her education as George Washington High School and a B.A. and J.D. from West Virginia University, and her occupation as lawyer.
It names her parents as Pat and John Charnock and lists her affiliations as Alpha Delta Pi Sorority and Elizabeth Memorial United Methodist Church.
Besides chairing Confirmations, her Senate committee assignments are Banking and Insurance, Economic Development, Energy, Industry and Mining, Government Organization, and Judiciary.
Her interim committees include the West Virginia Fusion Center Oversight Committee.

sources.title: Senator Anne B. Charnock (West Virginia Legislature)
